name: baseball-stats
description: 淡江航太系壘數據網站、PWA 與 Android App（網站本身不需建置）

scripts.test:mobile: node --test tests/pwa.test.cjs tests/cloud-api.test.cjs tests/cloud-sync.test.cjs tests/android-project.test.cjs && node tests/run-all.cjs ui-pwa ui-mobile-comfort ui-responsive
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.build:android: npm run cap:sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.build:android:release: npm run cap:sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs bundleRelease assembleRelease
